title: Why The World Keeps Minting More Billionaires
hook: While you were paying rent, the world minted 1,200 new billionaires.
closing: Billionaires got richer mostly by holding stocks, and anyone can own those too.
question: Lucky, or just well-invested? Tell me below.

segments.say: The billionaire club nearly doubled in a decade, to a record 3,028. That's the most the world has ever had.
Their combined fortune more than doubled, hitting 16.1 trillion dollars. So the club didn't just grow, the average pile did too.
Billionaire wealth rose 127 percent, but the stock market grew faster. Just owning the whole market would have beaten it.
